# EqualizerSoundEffect

- Inherits [`SoundEffect`](soundeffect.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("EqualizerSoundEffect")`

Three tone controls: the low notes, the middle and the high, each turned up or down. A radio is no lows and no highs; a voice through a wall is lows alone.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `HighGain` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The high band's level, in decibels, -80 to 12. |
| `LowGain` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The low band's level, in decibels, -80 to 12. |
| `MidGain` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The middle band's level, in decibels, -80 to 12. |
| `MidHigh` | `number` | `4000` | read/write | Where the middle band ends, in hertz. Above it is the high band. |
| `MidLow` | `number` | `400` | read/write | Where the middle band begins, in hertz. Below it is the low band. |
